crossRefs.note: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;
You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.
“You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.
“You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
“ ‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “ ‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am…
He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.
He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness…
But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous…
Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.
and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which…
In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
“Don’t keep talking so exceedingly proudly. Don’t let arrogance come out of your mouth, for Yahweh is a God of…
Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
There are six things which Yahweh hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:
There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.
The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the arrogance of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted…
Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways…
The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says…
Though you mount on high as the eagle, and though your nest is set among the stars, I will bring you down from there,”…
I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be…
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

translations.web: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.
translations.bsb: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
translations.kjv: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
translations.asv: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbor, him will I destroy: Him that hath a high look and a proud heart will I not suffer.
